why: Edith Baxter sees a man appear out of the darkness within thirty yards of the stables. The label names him only by where he was, without giving an identity.
Paragraph 21 states that the man carried a heavy stick with a knob to it.
Paragraph 21 describes his grey tweed suit, cloth cap and gaiters.
Paragraph 21 says he called to the maid to stop, and paragraph 20 places her walk to the stables at a few minutes after nine.
A plain question the story has clearly raised. Its wording does not point at any particular answer.
